question: Big Mom is a woman, but she uses the masculine pronoun, "Ore" (おれ). Why is this? Age 12
answer: Even today, there are regions of the country where women still use the pronoun "ore" when referring to themselves. In the past, it was once used equally by both men and women, so I didn't really think it was that unusal of an idea. But if that's weird to you, I'm surprised that I didn't get more questions about the pronoun that I completely invented for Ivankov, "Vatashi" (ヴァターシ).
